event.speaker: me
event.text: Hi, thanks for making time. I'm Ash, and basically I'm building a wearable speech coach this weekend.

event.speaker: other
event.text: Nice to meet you. What made you want to build that?

event.speaker: me
event.text: Honestly I noticed I talk fast when I get nervous, like really fast, and nobody ever tells you that in the moment.

event.speaker: other
event.text: That's fair. So how does it work when you're in an actual conversation like this one?

event.speaker: me
event.text: So basically the band hears the conversation and the phone buzzes once if I speed up way past my normal pace and basically everything else like interruptions and questions and how long I talk waits for the debrief so it never throws me off in the middle of a sentence and I can like stay present with the person in front of me which is basically the whole point and why we only buzz for one habit live

event.speaker: other
event.text: Okay, slow down, I'm with you. What happens after?

event.speaker: me
event.text: After, you get a short spoken debrief with like one thing to fix next time. What would you want it to catch?

event.speaker: other
event.text: Probably when I ramble in interviews.
